whole.title: What counts as one thing?
whole.description: A whole expression can act as a single quantity. Changing what you count together can make its structure easier to see—without changing its value.

product.title: Why do these groups multiply?
product.description: Distinguish the number of copies from the quantity in each copy, and test why the two groups multiply.

zero.title: What if the whole is zero?
zero.description: Why regrouping can preserve a zero-valued whole, while cancellation by division requires a nonzero factor.
